global_non_goals: Do not modify the original5185 worktree, published main, or frozen checkpoint evidence.
Root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and shared design documents require coordinator ownership and a serialized change request.
No new paid services, driver/security changes, or silent CPU fallback.

proof_scope.meaning: Record the exact proof route and write set after P0. Existing authorization covers semantics-preserving work; obtain a user choice only for a concrete substantive change to guarantees, semantics, or accepted evidence strength.

ownership_scope.meaning: Record the bounded source slice within the already approved intended design. Ask the user only for an actual semantic/design tradeoff; do not reconfirm routine implementation sequencing.

gpu_resources.meaning: Resolved closure fits the authorized storage/environment scope. Ask user only for an actual scope increase or system change; do not install drivers here.

optimization_choice.meaning: One concrete candidate and exact source write set chosen after tradeoffs are explained.

candidate_baseline.meaning: Exact matching baseline available; if the selected candidate affects GPU, add MG to V0 dependencies before dispatch.

blocks.title: Choose an exact runtime proof boundary
blocks.goal: Produce a source-connected proof contract and concrete translation/refactor alternatives before changing runtime semantics.
steps: Reproduce the six-lemma checkpoint and inspect the full-runtime and guard translation failures.
Define full-Session projection, Vec iteration, same-stack/same-bytes admission/charge, diagnostic observations, counter overflow and RAII obligations.
Compare keeping source unchanged, a small shared verification kernel, and another extraction route; identify exact affected files and migration effects.
Write proof-contract.json with observables, invariants, trusted stages, candidate write set and required positive/negative traces.
acceptance: Every gap has an explicit obligation and source anchor.
Recommended route has a bounded feasibility example; alternatives and substantive decisions are visible.
No conditional body lemma is relabeled as full-loop or guard correctness.
non_goals: No main merge, historical-evidence edits, new paid services, shared-ledger changes, or unassigned source changes.
Do not claim a complete runtime/compiler/language comparison from a narrower deliverable.

blocks.title: Define the ownership source slice and pass contracts
blocks.goal: Freeze the first end-to-end ownership slice and its compiler observations against the intended complete design.
steps: Validate frozen overlay availability and hashes; preserve original WIP.
Map source admission, specialization, ownership analysis, interpretation and Rust emission for owned buffer/tree cases.
Write source-contract.json specifying mandatory .cg positives, negatives, moves/loans, partial initialization/drop, regions, source spans and errors.
Assign every remaining intended feature to a later obligation; provide a precise proposed production write set.
acceptance: Library/analyzer-only support is distinct from accepted source.
Required positives cannot be counted as expected rejection.
Contract includes interpreter/emitter parity and authentication-versus-preservation distinction.
non_goals: No main merge, historical-evidence edits, new paid services, shared-ledger changes, or unassigned source changes.
Do not claim a complete runtime/compiler/language comparison from a narrower deliverable.

blocks.title: Freeze common fixture interfaces and independent oracles
blocks.goal: Turn the ten-case comparison protocol into a versioned correctness harness usable by disjoint language fixture workers.
steps: Implement contract.json and a runner accepting case_id, language, policy, target, input and output paths; use pinned typed JSON traces.
Implement independent value/error/failure/side-effect oracles for N01-N03, M01-M04 and G01-G03.
Define result.schema.json including correctness, status, native/logical/device charges, elapsed samples and source/backend hashes.
Mutation-test the oracle with wrong values, wrong boundary admission, hidden copies, missed synchronization and dropped errors.
acceptance: All ten cases retain exact dtype/input/error contracts and applicability.
Idiomatic/equipped policies and logical/native/RSS/device accounting remain separate.
Blocked, failed, unrun and inapplicable rows cannot become passes.
No implementation owns or can rewrite its own acceptance oracle.
non_goals: No main merge, historical-evidence edits, new paid services, shared-ledger changes, or unassigned source changes.
Do not claim a complete runtime/compiler/language comparison from a narrower deliverable.

blocks.title: Resolve the GPU package closure and storage bounds

steps: Read the version-specific ROCm remedy evidence; distinguish observed compatibility from official support.
Resolve exact CPython/Torch/ROCm dependencies, artifact hashes, unpacked/staging bounds and available disk using metadata where possible.
Write environment-contract.json with package pins, per-attempt scratch paths, storage cap and expected device checks.
If metadata cannot establish the closure or cap, return the precise blocker and concrete alternatives.
acceptance: The four-artifact compressed sum is not treated as the full installed footprint.
Driver replacement is not assumed; no system mutation or wheel installation occurs in this block.
Current and legacy ROCm stacks are not mixed.
non_goals: No main merge, historical-evidence edits, new paid services, shared-ledger changes, or unassigned source changes.

blocks.title: Run CPU comparisons
blocks.goal: Measure only contract-compatible CPU routes on a quiet pinned machine and produce case-specific scorecards.
steps: Acquire exclusive measurement_host; stop concurrent builds, installs, proof compilation and device work on the host.
Run correctness pilots, estimate noise/effect sizes and preregister practical thresholds before holdout measurements.
Measure cold/warm end-to-end costs, distributions, RSS/allocator/logical counters and implementation effort.
Retain all failures, raw samples and uncertainty; explain unfavorable/mixed/inconclusive findings.

Thresholds and exclusions precede holdout data.

blocks.title: Implement one selected optimization

steps: Require the recorded user choice and exact approved write set; expand this block before dispatch if the selected mechanism needs another component.
Add the candidate invariant/boundary/fault checks, then implement the smallest approved change.
Prove its relevant source-connected obligations and run equivalent before/after functional contracts.
Publish migration notes and all regressions; do not silently retain a losing tradeoff.
acceptance: Candidate matches the selected decision and baseline cases.
Success/error/ownership/guard observations are preserved or explicitly migrated.
A faster collector does not hide extra memory or changed admission.

Acquire measurement_host; rerun correctness, relevant proofs and paired resource/performance measurements.
Report practical effects, uncertainty, changed guarantees and migration burden.
Present unfavorable/mixed results to the user for the final candidate decision.
acceptance: Historical evidence remains immutable.
